blocks.text: Propositional equivalence propositional logic ka ek concept hai. Yeh batata hai ke do logical expressions kab ek hi matlab rakhte hain. Expressions dekhne mein mukhtalif hon tab bhi ek jaisa nateeja de sakte hain. Equivalence truth tables se check ki jati hai: agar do expressions ki truth values har soorat (case) mein ek jaisi hon to woh equivalent (barabar) hain. Equivalence dikhane ke liye nishaan “≡” istemal hota hai. Propositional equivalence reasoning ko saaf banati hai (Figure 2.6 dekhein).

blocks.alt: Box jo batata hai ke do propositional expressions mantiqi taur par barabar (equivalent) hain: Expression 1, (A AND NOT B) OR (B AND NOT A), aur Expression 2, (A OR B) AND (NOT A OR NOT B), dohre teer se jure; dono unhi suraton mein sach hain (XOR). Venn diagram mein sirf A wala aur sirf B wala hissa rangeen hai; mushtarka hissa aur bahar ka hissa khali. Truth table aur aakhri lakeer: Therefore, dono barabar hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: Do barabar (equivalent) propositional expressions, Venn diagram aur truth table se (kitab ki Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Key: A AND NOT B; B AND NOT A; Neither A nor B (na A na B); A AND B (shamil nahi). Truth table ki rows (A, B, Expression 1, Expression 2): F F F F; F T T T; T F T T; T T F F.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Expression 1 (A AND NOT B) OR (B AND NOT A) aur Expression 2 (A OR B) AND (NOT A OR NOT B) dono tab sach hain jab A aur B mein se sirf ek sach ho. Isay XOR (exclusive OR) kehte hain. Venn diagram mein sirf A wala aur sirf B wala hissa rang wala hai; beech ka mushtarka hissa khali hai. Truth table ke dono aakhri columns har row mein barabar hain (F, T, T, F), is liye dono expressions equivalent hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.6 ki key mein 'A AND B (not included)' ka khana dhaari daar (hatched) chhapa hai, halanke diagram mein A aur B ka mushtarka hissa khali hai kyunke woh shamil nahi. Sahi yeh hai ke yeh khana khali (bina rang) ho; upar ki figure mein yahi banaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Equivalent expressions dekhne mein mukhtalif ho sakte hain lekin hamesha ek hi nateeja dete hain; yeh mushkil logic ko aasan karne mein madad dete hain.

Equivalent expressions truth tables se pehchane jate hain. Har expression ko tamam mumkin truth values par test kiya jata hai. Agar har soorat mein nateeje mil jayein to woh equivalent hain. Logical laws (logic ke qanoon) bhi equivalence pehchanne mein madad dete hain aur expressions ko aasan banate hain. Equivalence pehchan kar mushkil expressions chhote kiye ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Logical law ki ek misal (kitab se aage): De Morgan ka qanoon kehta hai ke NOT (A AND B) ≡ (NOT A) OR (NOT B). Truth table bana kar check karein: har row mein dono taraf ki value barabar aati hai.

Equivalence is liye aham hai ke yeh logic ke masle aasan banati hai. Is se hum mushkil expression ki jagah aasan expression rakh sakte hain, jis se waqt aur mehnat bachti hai. Programming mein equivalent (aasan) expressions code ko zyada efficient (kam kaam mein behtar) banate hain. Equivalence logical ghaltiyon se bachati hai aur sahi reasoning aur sahi faisle yaqeeni banati hai. Yeh concept maths aur computer science dono mein kaam aata hai aur logical soch ko mazboot karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Truth table se check karein ke kya NOT (A OR B) ≡ (NOT A) AND (NOT B).
blocks.explanation: Rows (A, B): F F par dono taraf T; F T par dono F; T F par dono F; T T par dono F. Har row mein columns barabar hain, is liye dono expressions equivalent hain (yeh De Morgan ka doosra qanoon hai).

items: Equivalent: har soorat mein ek jaisi truth value; truth table se check karo; nishaan ≡.
Figure 2.6: (A AND NOT B) OR (B AND NOT A) ≡ (A OR B) AND (NOT A OR NOT B), yani XOR.
Equivalence logic aur code ko aasan banati hai aur ghaltiyon se bachati hai.
